description: This file defines a contract for session binding management across multiple communication channels, including capabilities, binding, unbinding, and cleanup procedures. It includes functions for managing session bindings, creating managers, and testing session states.

classes.name: SessionBindingContractEntry
classes.description: Defines the structure for session binding contract entries, including capabilities, binding, unbinding, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: getContractApi
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches contract API modules based on plugin ID.

methods.name: expectResolvedSessionBinding
methods.description: Asserts that a session binding has been correctly resolved for given parameters.

methods.name: unbindAndExpectClearedSessionBinding
methods.description: Unbinds a session and asserts that it has been cleared.

methods.name: expectClearedSessionBinding
methods.description: Asserts that a session binding has been cleared for given parameters.

methods.name: resetMatrixSessionBindingStateDir
methods.description: Removes and recreates the temporary directory used for Matrix session binding state.

methods.name: createContractMatrixThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Matrix thread binding manager for testing.

methods.name: getSessionBindingContractRegistry
methods.description: Returns the cached list of session binding contract entries for different channels.
